regime_read: The strongest measured convergence is in AI infrastructure, semiconductors, federal technology, and biopharma, but several channels are sentiment or affiliation rather than hard demand. CRWD and PLTR have coherent positive signals but are already extended, while the track record has only one scored observation, so conviction remains low.
regime_read_zh: 当前最强的可测量信号汇聚于AI基础设施、半导体、联邦科技支出和生物医药，但部分信号仅来自情绪或关联关系，并非硬需求。CRWD与PLTR的正面信号虽较一致，但股价已经过度延伸；同时历史记录仅有1个已评分样本，因此整体置信度保持偏低。

theses.thesis: IBM has one of the cleaner non-extended alignments: sharply accelerating federal-contract activity is accompanied by insider buying pressure, a large patent cluster, and open-source developer momentum [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]. Its substantial 60-day underperformance versus SPY leaves room for normalization, although earnings in 14 days add event risk.
theses.thesis_zh: IBM是较清晰且未过度延伸的信号组合之一：联邦合同活动显著加速，同时出现内部人士买入压力、较大的专利集群和开源开发者动能 [gov_contract_accel] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [github_momentum]。其过去60日相对SPY明显落后，为均值修复留下空间，但14天后公布业绩带来事件风险。
second_order: Federal IT modernization theme — IBM's contract acceleration points to continued public-sector technology spending.
Cybersecurity and hybrid-cloud suppliers — likely downstream participants if federal modernization budgets broaden.
theses.dissent: Contract acceleration may be lumpy, while weak relative performance could reflect deteriorating fundamentals that alternative signals have not captured.

falsifier.text: Federal contract momentum reverses and the next earnings report shows no corresponding improvement in demand or backlog.

theses.thesis: MU combines government support, insider buying pressure, patent activity, and uniformly bullish Stocktwits sentiment without being extended [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]. The disclosed Ro Khanna affiliation adds a policy-network signal [actor:Ro Khanna], but this is qualitative and should not be treated as proof of incremental demand.
theses.thesis_zh: MU同时具备政府支持、内部人士买入压力、专利活动和Stocktwits一致偏多情绪，且股价尚未过度延伸 [gov_grant] [insider_mspr] [patent_cluster] [stocktwits_bull]。已披露的Ro Khanna关联增加了政策网络信号 [actor:Ro Khanna]，但该信号属于定性信息，不能视为新增需求的证明。
second_order: AMAT — memory-capacity investment would support semiconductor-equipment demand, while AMAT also has its own congressional and patent signals.
Semiconductor equipment theme — a durable memory upcycle generally pulls forward fabrication spending.
theses.dissent: The grant acceleration is modest and bullish retail sentiment can be late-cycle enthusiasm rather than evidence of improving memory economics.

falsifier.text: Government support and insider pressure fail to translate into improving memory demand or capital-spending intentions over the next two reporting cycles.

theses.thesis: NVDA shows broad alignment across analyst upgrades, developer activity, patents, retail attention, and disclosed political holdings [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [retail_buzz] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]. Dark-pool activity is also unusually elevated in the supplied metrics, strengthening the accumulation read, and the stock is not flagged extended. However, several inputs are crowded or reflexive rather than independent end-demand measures.
theses.thesis_zh: NVDA在分析师上调、开发者活动、专利、散户关注和已披露的政治人物持仓之间呈现广泛一致性 [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [github_momentum] [patent_cluster] [retail_buzz] [actor:Nancy Pelosi] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Michael McCaul]。证据包中的暗池指标也异常偏高，增强了资金吸纳判断，且该股未被标记为过度延伸。不过，多项输入具有拥挤或自我强化特征，并非独立的终端需求指标。
second_order: MU — AI accelerator deployment increases demand for high-bandwidth and data-center memory.
AMAT — continued AI semiconductor capacity expansion can support fabrication-equipment spending.
AI power and data-center infrastructure theme — accelerator deployment requires additional power, cooling, and facility capacity.
theses.dissent: Analyst unanimity, retail buzz, and widely disclosed political holdings may reflect an already crowded consensus rather than fresh informational edge.

falsifier.text: Developer momentum and patent activity remain strong but customer AI infrastructure spending or accelerator demand materially slows.

theses.thesis: AZN's convergence is fundamentally oriented: Phase 3 starts, FDA approval activity, label expansion, and a special-situation signal align while relative performance remains weak [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]. This is more coherent than a sentiment-only setup, though one clinical halt and the absence of actor or ownership confirmation keep conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: AZN的信号汇聚更偏基本面：三期临床启动、FDA批准活动、适应症扩展和特殊事件信号相互呼应，同时相对表现仍然偏弱 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_approval] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation]。这比单纯依赖情绪的组合更连贯，但存在1项临床暂停，且缺少重要人物或持仓信号确认，因此置信度保持偏低。
second_order: Clinical-research-services theme — a broad Phase 3 pipeline can increase trial execution and data-management demand.
Biopharma manufacturing theme — approvals and label expansions can create follow-on production requirements.
theses.dissent: Pipeline breadth does not guarantee commercial success, and clinical attrition or weak launch economics could overwhelm the positive activity count.

falsifier.text: Major trial setbacks or weak commercialization prevent the approval and label-expansion activity from improving the portfolio outlook.

theses.thesis: CRWD has genuinely positive convergence from a 13F addition, congressional buying, analyst upgrades, and the supplied Trump-linked buy signal [13f_add] [congress_buy] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [trump]. However, its 60-day relative performance is above the extension threshold, so the evidence supports monitoring the underlying demand signal but not chasing the stock.
theses.thesis_zh: CRWD确有正面信号汇聚，包括13F增持、国会议员买入、分析师集中上调以及证据包中的特朗普关联买入信号 [13f_add] [congress_buy] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [trump]。然而，其过去60日相对表现已超过过度延伸阈值，因此这些证据支持继续观察需求信号，但不支持追高。
second_order: Cybersecurity platform theme — sustained institutional and government interest could spill over to adjacent security vendors.
Federal cyber-modernization suppliers — congressional interest may indicate broader public-sector security spending.
theses.dissent: Strong earnings or a new security-spending cycle could allow the extended momentum to persist despite poor entry asymmetry.

falsifier.text: The stock consolidates enough to remove the extension while institutional and congressional accumulation remains intact.

theses.thesis: PLTR's federal-contract acceleration aligns with bullish retail sentiment and disclosed political and fund affiliations [gov_contract_accel] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]. The underlying business signal is constructive, but 60-day relative performance is above the extension threshold and two channels are sentiment-driven, making the current entry unattractive.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR的联邦合同加速与散户看多情绪、已披露的政治人物持仓及基金关联相互呼应 [gov_contract_accel] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull] [actor:Marjorie Taylor Greene] [actor:Cathie Wood]。底层业务信号具有建设性，但过去60日相对表现已超过过度延伸阈值，而且两个渠道由情绪驱动，因此当前入场吸引力不足。
second_order: Federal AI software theme — contract acceleration suggests continued adoption of data and decision platforms.
Government cloud and integration suppliers — broader deployments can require adjacent infrastructure and implementation capacity.
theses.dissent: Federal-contract growth could remain strong enough for earnings revisions to outrun the elevated price trend.

falsifier.text: The stock works off its extension while federal-contract acceleration persists and sentiment does not deteriorate.
